card.name: "Of" after treatment of any condition
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "treatment" (or "treat"/"treat a") just before a phrase like "any medical condition" or "any concomitant medical problems". Seen in disclaimers and in neuroleptic malignant syndrome management text.

modes.label: Disclaimer wording
modes.description: "of" or "a" after diagnosis/treatment or "diagnose or treat" in the standard information-only warning.
modes.example: The information provided herein should not be used during any medical emergency or for the diagnosis or treatment<< of>> any medical condition.

modes.label: Treatment list item
modes.description: "of" after "treatment" in a numbered list of management steps, leading into any concomitant medical problems.
modes.example: 2) intensive symptomatic treatment and medical monitoring, and 3) treatment<< of>> any concomitant serious medical problems for

card.writes: It leans toward words naming health problems or harms, such as ailments and offenses, as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word after "treatment" or "treat" when a named illness or medical problem comes next.
